14: // ConfirmDelete reports whether a delete should proceed. When yes is set it
15: // returns true without prompting. Otherwise it requires an interactive
16: // terminal, resolves a display name (calling fetchName only when a prompt is
17: // actually needed, so a --yes delete makes no extra API call), and prompts for
18: // y/N. fetchName may be nil, in which case fallbackName is shown. The caller
19: // decides what a declined delete means (return nil, or an error).
20: func ConfirmDelete(ios *iostreams.IOStreams, yes bool, noun, fallbackName string, fetchName func() (string, error)) (bool, error) {
21: 	if yes {
22: 		return true, nil
23: 	}

25: 	if !ios.CanPrompt() {
26: 		return false, fmt.Errorf("--yes is required in non-interactive mode")
27: 	}
